name: facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/core/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.create_environment_instance: create an Environment instance wrapping a gym environment for reinforcement learning
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.run_environment_initial: run the initial method to reset the gym environment and get the first observation
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.step_environment_action: step the Environment with a torch action tensor to advance the gym environment
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.review_environment_close: review the Environment close method to properly shut down the underlying gym environment
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.summarize_format_frame: summarize the _format_frame function that converts numpy frames to PyTorch tensors with T,B dimensions

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.create_FileWriter: create a FileWriter instance to log experiment data to CSV files under a custom root directory
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.log_with_FileWriter: log a dictionary of key-value metrics to the FileWriter CSV log file with auto incrementing ticks
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.close_FileWriter: close the FileWriter and save final metadata including end date and success status to meta.json
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.gather_metadata: gather git commit info, slurm environment variables, and process environment into a metadata dictionary
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.save_metadata_FileWriter: save the experiment metadata dictionary to a JSON file using the FileWriter internal _save_metadata method

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.create_timings_profiler: create a Timings instance to profile code sections with online mean and variance tracking
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.time_named_event: call the time method on a Timings object to record elapsed time for a named event
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.get_profiling_means: call the means method on a Timings object to retrieve a dictionary of mean timings per event
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.get_profiling_stds: call the stds method on a Timings object to retrieve standard deviations for each timed event
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.print_profiling_summary: call the summary method on a Timings object to get a formatted string of all timings with percentages

facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.compute_vtrace_from_logits: compute V-trace off-policy actor-critic targets from behavior and target policy logits with importance weighting
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.compute_vtrace_from_importance_weights: compute V-trace returns from log importance weights, rewards, discounts, and values using backward accumulation
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.compute_action_log_probs: compute the log probabilities of taken actions given policy logits using negative log-likelihood loss
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.review_VTraceFromLogitsReturns_namedtupl: review the VTraceFromLogitsReturns namedtuple structure containing vs, pg_advantages, log_rhos, and action log probs fields
facebookresearch_torchbeast/torchbeast/c.review_VTraceReturns_namedtuple: review the VTraceReturns namedtuple structure containing vs and pg_advantages fields for V-trace targets
